Caesar-style salad: romaine dressed in creamy dressing, possibly with parmesan. The plate is a large square, about 26 cm. The salad covers roughly 12×18 cm in a loose pile, which I estimate at about 120 g. Dressed salad of this kind runs about 1.2–1.5 kcal/g, giving roughly 160 kcal.
